name: Chalet Willis Ruh
beschreibung:
Quietly situated by the forest edge in Seefeld, Chalet Willis Ruh promises pure relaxation amidst tranquil nature. This stylish lodge showcases natural timber architecture, expansive rooms, and an inviting alpine atmosphere.

Scenic hiking paths, leisure walks, and in winter the award-winning Seefeld cross-country ski network begin right outside the property, with the town centre just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Chalet Willis Ruh in Seefeld in Tirol provides an idyllic forest-edge retreat and exclusive comfort on the sunny high plateau.
